subject.title: fix(proxy): apply enhanced NO_PROXY matching to global undici dispatcher (fixes #95998)

question: Should OpenClaw accept an opt-in global Undici enhanced NO_PROXY bypass that lets configured CIDR/octet-wildcard NO_PROXY destinations connect directly instead of through the env proxy?
rationale: The code defect is mechanically fixable, but the broader egress-boundary choice is a maintainer policy decision because this feature intentionally bypasses the configured proxy for matching destinations.

options.title: Accept opt-in after fixes
options.body: Fix rollback/default handling and docs formatting, then land the default-off config as an explicit operator-controlled bypass mode.

options.title: Reject global bypass
options.body: Keep global Undici behavior on the dependency-native NO_PROXY matcher and solve the linked issue through a narrower plugin/provider request path.

options.title: Require managed-proxy design first
options.body: Pause this PR until the proxy docs and managed-proxy lifecycle explicitly define how NO_PROXY should interact with `proxy.enabled` and Proxyline.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in after fixes
recommendation.body: Fix rollback/default handling and docs formatting, then land the default-off config as an explicit operator-controlled bypass mode.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent proxy-env helper and docs history makes this the best available routing owner for the egress-boundary decision.
